datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select id,
       name,
      to_char(id)||'-'||name as KOD from customers
where id in (select customerid from sbcm_contracts_new)
order by id

datasets.name: Deps
datasets.sql:
select
   cont.id,
   cont.contractno,
   sbcm_stored_programs_new.Get_ContractAccount(Acc.Contractaccid) as ContractAccNO
from sbcm_contracts_new cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts_new acc
where cont.id = acc.id#

datasets.name: ReportData
datasets.sql:
SELECT cont.contractno, av.val_name,
       --sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_customernamebyid (cont.customerid)
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.Get_ContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid)
                                                                  AS custname,
       cont.customerid as custID,
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_contract_BalNo(Cont.ID) as Balans,
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_contractaccount (acc.contractaccid
                                                ) AS contractaccno,
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_contractaccount (acc.interestaccid
                                                ) AS interestaccno,
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_contractaccount (acc.clientaccid
                                                ) AS clientaccno,
       cont.opendate, cont.closedate, cont.amount,cont.amount* o.ostat as eamount,   intr.interest,
       dueintr.overdueinterest, dueintr.dueinterest, h.facticaldebt,
       h.facticaldebt * o.ostat AS efacticaldebt, h.facticalinterestdebt,
       h.facticalinterestdebt * o.ostat AS efacticalinterestdebt,
       cat.CATEGORY, per.NAME as pername, dt.TYPE, fil.NAME as filname,
       h.facticaldebt+h.facticalinterestdebt as Payamt,
       h.facticaldebt* o.ostat +h.facticalinterestdebt* o.ostat  as EPayamt,
       sbcm_stored_programs_new.get_firstclosedat(cont.id) as firstopdate
  FROM sbcm_contracts_new cont,
       sbcm_contract_accounts_new acc,
       sbcm_contract_history_new h,
       sbcm_interests_new intr,
       sbcm_overdueinterests_new dueintr,
       operkurs o,
       sbcm_categories_new cat,
       filial fil,
       sbcm_deposit_types_new dt,
       sbcm_persons_new per,
       avalute av
 WHERE h.hdate = :dat
   AND o.dat = :dat
   AND cont.ID = acc.id#
   AND cont.ID = h.id#
   AND cont.ID = intr.id#
   AND cont.ID = dueintr.id#
   AND cont.currency = o.val_kod
   AND cont.currency = av.valute
   AND cont.clienttype = cat.ID
   AND cont.branchid = fil.ID
   AND cont.contracttype = dt.ID
   AND cont.personaltype = per.ID and cont.type# in (3,4)

datasets.name: Contracts
datasets.sql:
select contractaccid,    
      sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccountName(contractaccid) as Name
 from sbcm_contract_accounts
